title: Beautiful but horrible to set up by yourself
text: Beautiful but horrible to set up by yourself. I have such mixed reviews on this. I found it totally awful to put together. It was completely frustrating. But the end result is beautiful. Really lovely tables. But god that was annoying to do by myself. Have someone help if you can!

Use this multi-functional set as end tables, lamp tables, decorative display tables, or simply as accent pieces for any living space.
